description:
Create a new order in StarShipIt. The order will appear in the unshipped queue ready for label generation.

**When to use:** Call this when a new order has been placed and needs to be imported into StarShipIt for fulfilment.

**Parameters (all under `order` object):**
- `order_number` (required) — Merchant order number (must be unique)
- `destination` (required) — Recipient address (name, street, post_code, country are required)
- `order_date` (optional) — ISO timestamp when the order was placed
- `reference` (optional) — Secondary reference (e.g. customer PO)
- `carrier` / `carrier_name` (optional) — Pre-assign a carrier
- `shipping_method` (optional) — Service level (e.g. "Express")
- `signature_required` (optional) — Require signature on delivery
- `return_order` (optional) — Mark as a return order
- `items` (optional) — Array of line items
- `packages` (optional) — Array of package dimensions/weights

**Returns:** Created Order object with assigned `order_id`.

**Errors:** 400 if required fields missing or invalid; 409 if order_number already exists; 401 if API keys invalid.

country.description: Country name (e.g. Australia) or ISO code (e.g. AU)

state.description: State or province code (e.g. NSW, VIC)

items.description: Line items in the order (products / goods)

dangerous_goods.description: Whether item is classified as dangerous goods

hs_code.description: Harmonised System (HS) tariff code for customs

order_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the order was placed (e.g. 2024-01-15T09:00:00Z)

order_number.description: Merchant order number (required when creating an order)

reference.description: Secondary reference field (e.g. customer PO number)

return_order.description: True if this is a return / reverse-logistics order

signature_required.description: Whether a recipient signature is required on delivery

name: starshipit_create_order

outputSchema.description: Raw StarShipIt API response; not truncated

errors.description: Validation or processing errors returned by StarShipIt

object.description: The response payload when StarShipIt returns a non-object value

success.description: StarShipIt success flag (a boolean on most endpoints)

title: Create Order
